answers.core: I believe that it's a feature that would benefit to everyone and which should be embedded in Godot by default. That being said, since the VS Code extension already supports it I suppose that it may be possible to implement it as an add-on.
answers.workaround:
This enhancement would definitely be often used:

- it has been requested in Godot's main repository: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/27607
- the [VSCode extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=geequlim.godot-tools) supports it: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/177#issuecomment-595926144
